test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a fact mentioned in the passage?

options.text: Exercise releases endorphins, contributing to improved mental well-being
Exercise requires intense workouts for mental health benefits.
Regular exercise has no impact on mental health
Only intense physical activities are linked to reduced anxiety and depression.

solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1. 

Exercise releases endorphins, contributing to improved mental well-being, is a fact mentioned in the passage, highlighting its positive impact on mental health.
